channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Famous quantum effect now predictable in real materials
item.description: Scientists have developed a new method to calculate the Kondo effect, a quantum phenomenon that appears when magnetic atoms are embedded in materials.

item.title: Loneliness may cost nearly 6 years of good health
item.description: A large study suggests loneliness and social isolation can reduce years of healthy life, especially for mental health. Men are particularly affected.

item.title: MIT astronomers observe star consuming brown dwarf over billions of years
item.description: Astronomers found a star system about 300 light-years away where a small star is slowly consuming a nearby brown dwarf.
